input.summary: I added three DOM buttons (Red, Blue, Black) below the canvas in `src/main.ts`. Each one swaps the car body's base paint colour at runtime and also updates the dim mirrored copy of the car in the floor. The clear coat, flake normal map, chrome, glass and wheels are unchanged. Red is the starting colour. The selected button gets an outline. `window.__TASK_STATE__` now also carries `paintColor: 'red' | 'blue' | 'black'`, updated every frame and on each click. Typecheck passes. I could not click the buttons in the render tool. To test the repaint path I temporarily called the blue handler on load, and the render showed a blue body with a matching floor reflection. I then removed that call, so the final build starts red and I have not re-rendered it. Red, blue and black all use the same repaint call, but only blue was rendered, so the blue and black base colours and metallic values are untuned guesses. The earlier red paint also still looked pale pink on the lower flanks in the last renders rather than a deep candy red.
